# CWE-319: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information — IaC Detection Guide

## Core Weaknesses to Detect

### 1. Insecure Protocol Configuration
Transmission channels configured to use unencrypted protocols instead of their secure counterparts.

| Weakness | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Unencrypted protocol explicitly set | `protocol`, `scheme`, `endpoint`, `url`, `connection_string` containing `http://`, `ftp://`, `telnet://`, `ldap://`, `smtp://`, `ws://` |
| Insecure default port usage | `port: 80`, `port: 21`, `port: 23`, `port: 25`, `port: 389`, `port: 1080` |

---

### 2. TLS/SSL Enforcement Disabled
Settings that explicitly disable or do not enforce encryption in transit.

| Weakness | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| SSL/TLS disabled | `ssl_enabled`, `tls_enabled`, `enable_ssl`, `require_ssl`, `ssl_enforcement` set to `false`, `disabled`, `"Disabled"`, `0`, `off` |
| HTTPS-only not enforced | `enable_https_traffic_only`, `https_only`, `force_https`, `require_https`, `http_only` set to `false` |
| Secure transfer not required | `secure_transfer_required`, `require_secure_transport`, `in_transit_encryption`, `encrypt_in_transit` set to `false`, `OFF`, `disabled` |

---

### 3. Weak or Absent Minimum TLS Version
Permitting deprecated TLS/SSL versions that are known to be compromised.

| Weakness | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Minimum TLS version too low | `minimum_tls_version`, `min_tls_version`, `tls_policy`, `ssl_policy`, `security_policy` set to `TLS1.0`, `TLS1.1`, `SSLv3`, `SSLv2`, `TLS_1_0`, `TLS_1_1` |

---

### 4. Insecure Listener or Load Balancer Configuration
Infrastructure components accepting or forwarding unencrypted traffic without enforcing a redirect.

| Weakness | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Plaintext listener active | `listener` block with `protocol: HTTP`, `protocol: TCP` (without TLS), `protocol: FTP` |
| No HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect | `redirect_http_to_https`, `http_to_https_redirect`, `http_redirect` absent or set to `false` |
| Permissive viewer/origin policy | `viewer_protocol_policy: allow-all`, `viewer_protocol_policy: http-only`, `origin_protocol_policy: http-only` |

---

### 5. Database / Cache / Messaging Without In-Transit Encryption

| Weakness | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Database SSL disabled | `ssl_mode: disable`, `sslmode: disable`, `ssl: false`, `require_ssl: false` |
| Cache cluster not encrypted | `transit_encryption_enabled: false`, `in_transit_encryption_enabled: false` |
| Message bus unencrypted | `transport_security`, `tls`, `encryption` absent in broker/queue configuration |

---

### 6. Cookie Missing Secure Flag
Cookies transmitting session or credential data over HTTP.

| Weakness | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| Secure flag absent or false | `secure`, `secure_flag`, `cookie_secure` set to `false` or absent in session/cookie configuration |

---

### 7. API Gateway / CDN Allowing HTTP
Endpoints that allow cleartext HTTP access to sensitive APIs.

| Weakness | Keywords / Attributes / Fields |
|---|---|
| API accepts HTTP | `endpoint_type`, `protocol`, `listener_protocol`, `ingress` configured with plain `HTTP` |
| No forced TLS on ingress | `tls` block absent, `annotations` lacking forced HTTPS, `insecure_http: true` |

---

## Summary of High-Signal Keywords

```
http://, ftp://, telnet://, ldap://, ws://
ssl_enabled: false
tls_enabled: false
https_only: false
enable_https_traffic_only: false
require_ssl: false
ssl_enforcement: Disabled
minimum_tls_version: TLS1.0 / TLS1.1
sslmode: disable
transit_encryption_enabled: false
in_transit_encryption: false
encrypt_in_transit: false
viewer_protocol_policy: allow-all
origin_protocol_policy: http-only
secure: false  (in cookie context)
port: 80 / 21 / 23 / 25 / 389
redirect_http_to_https: false
```

Any IaC resource exposing these patterns—especially in storage accounts, databases, load balancers, API gateways, CDN distributions, or messaging brokers—should be flagged as a potential CWE-319 instance.

package glitch

is_disabled(value) {
    value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    value.value == false
}

is_disabled(value) {
    value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)^(false|disabled|off|0|no)$", value.value)
}

is_disabled(value) {
    value.ir_type == "Integer"
    value.value == 0
